'''Headhunter Flight''' was the fighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[Vandangante outlaw techs]] that was quickly assembled when their base, on [[Sarlucif]], was incurred upon by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. At the time of the invasion, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was present, negotiating a deal with [[Jessa Vandangante]] to receive upgrades for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. In an effort to save his disabled ship, Solo assumed the role of [[Headhunter Leader]]. The squadron consisted of six [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|ships]] in three two-ship elements. Han's wingman was [[Headhunter Two]]. Jessa used the call sign of [[Headhunter Three]], while her [[Lafrarian]] wingman flew [[Headhunter Four]]. [[Headhunter Five]] and [[Headhunter Six]] were flown by two [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] brothers.
